assets.scope: Standee batch 1 repaint. The first eternal-bone-giant standee draft was reviewed and REJECTED: it stood as a gaunt, lanky straight skeleton that reads as a thin line at 48px, while its own flat token is a BULKY, hunched bone giant. The rejected draft is archived under art/token-layers/eternal-bone-giant/standee/superseded/master-v1.png. This second artwork is used only for the upright standee layer at <=48px cells. Identity evidence: the shipped native sprite and the shipped flat token, both pinned below; the game was not launched for this round. Flat 128px token, its master and the manifest mapping are untouched.
assets.gate_reason: The first standee draft was rejected for its silhouette: gaunt and lanky instead of the bulky, hunched build of its own flat token, and it reads as a thin line at 48px. A replacement upright standee is required for the standee layer only; the flat token, its master and the manifest mapping are unchanged.
assets.desc: A towering creature, made from the bones of hundreds of dead bodies. It is covered by an unholy aura.

references.note: The shipped flat eternal-bone-giant token: copy its matte painted miniature finish, colours and value structure. Ignore its top-down camera and its physical disc entirely - the standee has no disc.
Native eternal-bone-giant sprite: identity cue only. Keep the same species, gear, colours and markings, converted to a true upright standing composition; it is not a pose or proportion specification.
The shipped generic bone giant token shares this skeleton body plan, so it is the token this one must stay clearly distinct from; do not copy its pose or proportion.

assets.render_evidence_note: No fixture run. Identity-render evidence is the pinned native sprite PNG and the shipped flat token PNG; the desc line in the pinned native NPC source is the appearance authority.

prompt_fields.subject: eternal bone giant: a BULKY, heavy giant skeleton built from hundreds of fused dead bodies, standing upright on two long legs with a deep forward stoop, a broad barrel ribcage, heavy shoulders rising into a hump, long thick arms hanging straight down at the sides with the hands beside the thighs, and a dense cluster of fused skulls massed across the shoulders and upper back around one large central skull. Match the shipped flat token's thick, powerful, hunched silhouette and its pale aged bone colour.
prompt_fields.contrast: Hunched and broad, never lanky or straight: the skull sits low and forward between the raised shoulder masses and the torso is wide and heavy, but the shoulder span stays no wider than the ribcage. It must stay clearly distinct from the heavy bone giant (tall, upright, plated with armoured bone) and from the runed bone giant (lean, straight-backed, covered in red runes). It holds no weapon and its hands do not touch the ground.
prompt_fields.composition: Full body, standing upright with a heavy forward stoop, front three-quarter view, the broad shoulders humped forward, both long arms hanging straight down close to the sides with the hands beside the thighs, feet planted together under the body. The whole figure is clearly taller than broad, overall height to width about 1.7 to 1.
prompt_fields.palette: aged bone-white and warm light-umber bone, dark cracks and hollows, dim blue-violet shadow in the eye sockets and joints; no red runes, no aura, glow or particles.

prompt_fields.subject: snow giant boulder thrower: a towering, hugely muscled bald giant with TAN / UMBER skin, a broad flat face with small lower tusks, bare muscular arms and chest crossed by dark brown leather harness straps, a heavy brown leather kilt with a studded belt, both arms raised straight overhead steadying one huge rough mottled white-grey granite boulder. Match the shipped flat token's tan/umber skin, its dark leather harness and its brown kilt exactly.
prompt_fields.contrast: Taller than wide: stand at full height with the arms vertical and the boulder directly above the head, adding height but no width. Keep the elbows in; do not spread the arms. Its tan/umber skin, bare harness and bald head separate it from the pale blue-grey, fur-wrapped snow giants.
prompt_fields.composition: Full body, upright standing front view, both arms raised overhead holding one big mottled granite boulder, feet planted apart, the head just below the boulder. Overall height to width about 1.7 to 1, with the boulder allowed above the head.
prompt_fields.palette: tan and umber brown skin with warm shadows, dark brown leather harness and kilt with a studded belt, mottled white-grey granite boulder with dark speckles.

prompt_fields.subject: champion of Urh'Rok: an armoured demonic champion standing upright in full plate armour of POLISHED SILVER STEEL with a tall horned helm, broad layered pauldrons and greaves, thin glowing RED seams and cracks running along the joints of the plates, and both hands resting on the pommel of a great sword planted point-down in front of him. Match the shipped flat token's clean polished silver plate and its thin red glowing seams.
prompt_fields.contrast: Taller than wide: the plate silhouette is compact and upright, the sword is held vertically in front of the body and the two curved helm horns are the tallest marks. It must read as polished silver steel, not black iron; the red is only thin glowing seams between the plates, never a red body, full red glow, aura or particles.
prompt_fields.composition: Full body, upright standing front view, both hands on the pommel of the great sword planted point-down at the centre of the body, the horned helm at the top of the frame. Overall height to width about 1.6 to 1.
prompt_fields.palette: polished silver steel with cool grey highlights and dark shadowed recesses, thin glowing blood-red seam lines between the plates, dark leather under-layer.
